concerns.text: The plan states that PubMed (Entrez) will be used to “retrieve full‑text articles to obtain means/SDs” (see research.md, line 31). Full‑text articles are often behind paywalls and not guaranteed to be openly downloadable, which conflicts with Constitution VI’s requirement that all external sources be openly downloadable. This creates a feasibility risk: the pipeline may fail to acquire the necessary outcome statistics for many trials.
